zh.title: 产品广告：三秒抓人，十秒讲清
zh.summary: 产品广告不是产品展示片。前三秒给问题，中段给一个卖点，结尾给一个动作。

zh.title: 纪录短片：拍到一个变化
zh.summary: 先找到一个人，再等一件事发生。片子成立，往往是因为开机前后他变了点什么。

zh.title: 品牌片：先让人相信一句话
zh.summary: 品牌片不解释参数，它让观众记住一个态度。产品只是证据，不是主角。

zh.title: 封面缩到 200 像素，还认得出吗
zh.summary: 手机上的封面只有拇指大。先保证一张脸、一个动作、一个对比，再谈字。

zh.title: 竖屏短剧：前三秒先让人物要东西
zh.summary: 竖屏没有时间铺世界。第一屏让人物想要一个东西，第三秒让观众知道谁挡着，最后留一个没答的问题。

zh.title: 口播：写给耳朵，不是写给眼睛
zh.summary: 口播不是把文章念出来。观众听不见标点，只听得见意思。句子要短，转折要早，例子要具体；一口气说不完，就分成两句。

zh.title: 旅拍 Vlog 结构：先给一个地方的理由
zh.summary: 旅拍 Vlog 先给一个去这里的理由，再拍好看；没有理由，风景只是屏保。

zh.title: MV 结构：歌是时间轴
zh.summary: MV 结构跟歌走：主歌给空间，副歌给记忆点，桥段给转折。

zh.title: 婚礼片结构：先保仪式，再谈风格
zh.summary: 婚礼片先保仪式和誓言，再谈慢动作和调色；仪式没拍到，风格救不回来。

zh.title: 口播拉片：60 秒怎么留住人
zh.summary: 按 60 秒口播的通用结构，拆 8 个时间码：结论、原因、例子一、例子二、反方、证据、应用、问题。

zh.title: 口播模板：一句话、三个例子、一个动作
zh.summary: 口播模板一句话主张、三个例子、一个动作；例子必须能被镜头看见。

zh.title: 产品广告拉片：问题怎么变成证据
zh.summary: 按 60 秒产品广告的通用结构，拆 9 个时间码：问题、失败、产品、演示、证据、异议、第二证据、结果、行动。

zh.title: 产品广告模板：三秒问题、十秒证明
zh.summary: 产品广告模板前三秒给问题，十秒给证明，最后五秒给一个动作。

zh.title: 纪录短片拉片：一个人、一件事、一个变化
zh.summary: 按 3 分钟纪录短片的通用结构，拆 8 个时间码：动作、人物、欲望、阻碍、尝试、代价、变化、之后。

zh.title: 纪录模板：一个人、一件事、一个变化
zh.summary: 纪录模板一个人、一件具体的事、一个能看见的变化；不要从时代开始讲。

zh.title: 品牌片拉片：90 秒怎么建立世界
zh.summary: 按 90 秒品牌片的通用结构，拆 9 个时间码：世界、人物、欲望、阻碍、转向、行动、落点、一句话、停留。

zh.title: 品牌片模板：主张、证据、落点
zh.summary: 品牌片模板立场、证据、落点；立场要能被反对，证据要具体。

zh.title: 短剧拉片：30 秒一个反转
zh.summary: 按 30 秒短剧的通用结构，拆 8 个时间码：画面钩子、结论、设定、升级、假答案、真线索、反转、反应。

zh.title: 短剧模板：30 秒一个钩子
zh.summary: 短剧模板每三十秒一个钩子：新信息、新阻碍、新代价。

zh.title: Vlog 拉片：90 秒一个发现
zh.summary: 按 90 秒旅拍 Vlog 的通用结构，拆 8 个时间码：动作、地点、任务、阻碍、失败、发现、安静、离开。

zh.title: Vlog 模板：出发、遇到、改变
zh.summary: Vlog 模板出发、遇到、改变；改变可以很小，但必须发生。

zh.title: 新闻结构：先给现场，再给核实
zh.summary: 新闻结构先给现场，再给核实；先讲背景，观众已经走了。

zh.title: 新闻拉片：90 秒怎么把未知留在片里
zh.summary: 按 90 秒新闻短片的通用结构，拆 8 个时间码：已核实事实、现场、目击者、资料、背景、已知/未知、未解、下一步。

zh.title: 新闻模板：现场、背景、影响
zh.summary: 新闻模板现场、背景、影响；每一段都要回答一个观众的问题。

zh.title: 教程结构：一个问题只教一件事
zh.summary: 教程结构一个问题只教一件事；塞进三个技巧，观众一个也学不会。

zh.title: 教程拉片：5 分钟怎么让人学会
zh.summary: 按 5 分钟教程的通用结构，拆 10 个时间码：结果、材料、三步、检查、失败、复盘、下一步、行动。

zh.title: 教程模板：目标、步骤、验收
zh.summary: 教程模板目标、步骤、验收；每一步都要有可观察的结果。

zh.title: MV 拉片：歌的结构怎么变成画面
zh.summary: 按 3 分半 MV 的通用结构，拆 9 个时间码：前奏母题、主歌、预副歌、副歌、主歌二、桥段、副歌二、尾奏、停留。

zh.title: MV 模板：主歌、副歌、记忆点
zh.summary: MV 模板主歌、副歌、记忆点；记忆点可以是一个动作或一个画面。

zh.title: 婚礼拉片：6 分钟怎么不拍成流程
zh.summary: 按 6 分钟婚礼片的通用结构，拆 11 个时间码：准备、到场、仪式、誓言、戒指、家人、宴会、舞会、安静、肖像、离开。

zh.title: 婚礼模板：开场、仪式、祝福
zh.summary: 婚礼模板开场、仪式、祝福；开场给一天的感觉，不是给婚纱特写。

zh.title: 活动片结构：先给结果，再给过程
zh.summary: 活动片先给结果，再给过程；观众要知道这场活动成了什么。

zh.title: 活动片拉片：90 秒怎么讲清现场
zh.summary: 按 90 秒活动片的通用结构，拆 8 个时间码：到场、规模、关键瞬间、细节、人、高潮、之后、落版。

zh.title: 活动片模板：开场、现场、收束
zh.summary: 活动片模板开场、现场、收束；现场段落要有环境声，不要全铺音乐。

zh.title: 访谈结构：问题比机位重要
zh.summary: 访谈结构里问题比机位重要；问题太空，回答只能空。

zh.title: 采访拉片：3 分钟怎么让人物成立
zh.summary: 按 3 分钟采访片的通用结构，拆 9 个时间码：答案钩子、人物在工作、问题一、证据、问题二、转向、语境、收束、停留。

zh.title: 访谈模板：人物、问题、场景
zh.summary: 访谈模板人物、问题、场景；先拍他能做事的地方，再坐下来讲。

zh.title: 实验影像结构：规则先于效果
zh.summary: 实验影像先立规则：固定机位、重复动作、单一颜色；规则越清楚，效果越强。

zh.title: 实验影像拉片：规则、重复、打破
zh.summary: 按 4 分钟实验片的通用结构，拆 8 个时间码：前规则、规则、重复三次、打破、后果、停止。

zh.title: 企业宣传结构：六个拍点
zh.summary: 企业宣传不是公司简介视频。先写一个观众愿意看完的问题，再用一个人、一个动作证明公司解决了它。

zh.title: 企业宣传拉片：六个段落怎么落地
zh.summary: 综合样例：把企业宣传拆成六拍，逐段看画面、声音和通过线；示例数字只作示范，不是客户数据。

zh.title: 企业宣传模板：一张表拍完
zh.summary: 企业宣传一张表：六拍、画面、声音、时长与通过线；开机前填完，现场只认这张表。

zh.title: 运动短片结构：六个拍点
zh.summary: 运动短片不是慢动作集锦。先定一个动作目标：赢、复出、还是接受失败；让身体承担叙事，不靠旁白解释。

zh.title: 运动短片拉片：六个段落怎么落地
zh.summary: 综合样例：把运动短片拆成六拍，逐段看画面、声音和通过线；示例数字只作示范，不是客户数据。

zh.title: 运动短片模板：一张表拍完
zh.summary: 运动短片一张表：六拍、画面、声音、时长与通过线；开机前填完，现场只认这张表。

zh.title: 美食桌面结构：六个拍点
zh.summary: 美食片不是旋转托盘。先拍“变化”：生到熟、冷到热、整到碎；声音是第二主菜，手比嘴更有说服力。

zh.title: 美食桌面拉片：六个段落怎么落地
zh.summary: 综合样例：把美食桌面拆成六拍，逐段看画面、声音和通过线；示例数字只作示范，不是客户数据。

zh.title: 美食桌面模板：一张表拍完
zh.summary: 美食桌面一张表：六拍、画面、声音、时长与通过线；开机前填完，现场只认这张表。

zh.title: 房产空间结构：六个拍点
zh.summary: 房产片不是广角扫楼。先给“谁住进来”的生活问题，再用空间证明；每个镜头回答一个居住问题。

zh.title: 房产空间拉片：六个段落怎么落地
zh.summary: 综合样例：把房产空间拆成六拍，逐段看画面、声音和通过线；示例数字只作示范，不是客户数据。

zh.title: 房产空间模板：一张表拍完
zh.summary: 房产空间一张表：六拍、画面、声音、时长与通过线；开机前填完，现场只认这张表。

zh.title: 时尚美妆结构：六个拍点
zh.summary: 时尚美妆不是模特走秀。先定“质感”：布料、皮肤、光；用近景和动作证明，不靠滤镜磨皮。

zh.title: 时尚美妆拉片：六个段落怎么落地
zh.summary: 综合样例：把时尚美妆拆成六拍，逐段看画面、声音和通过线；示例数字只作示范，不是客户数据。

zh.title: 时尚美妆模板：一张表拍完
zh.summary: 时尚美妆一张表：六拍、画面、声音、时长与通过线；开机前填完，现场只认这张表。

zh.title: 直播播客结构：六个拍点
zh.summary: 直播/播客不是把长视频放上来。先设计“可截断的单元”，每 3–5 分钟一个完整问题，观众随时进来都懂。

zh.title: 直播播客拉片：六个段落怎么落地
zh.summary: 综合样例：把直播播客拆成六拍，逐段看画面、声音和通过线；示例数字只作示范，不是客户数据。

zh.title: 直播播客模板：一张表拍完
zh.summary: 直播播客一张表：六拍、画面、声音、时长与通过线；开机前填完，现场只认这张表。

zh.title: 短剧：模板、拆解、剧本
zh.summary: 短剧不是把长片剪短；模板、拆解和剧本要围绕一个 30 秒钩子重新排。

zh.title: 品牌片：模板、拆解、企业结构
zh.summary: 品牌片不是企业简介；一个卖点、一个人物和一个可记住的动作比十个部门更重要。

zh.title: 纪录片：模板、拆解、伦理
zh.summary: 纪录片不是把真实拍下来；模板、拆解和伦理决定你保留了谁的声音。

zh.title: MV：模板、结构、拆解
zh.summary: MV 不是把歌配画面；结构、表演和剪辑点要跟着音乐走，而不是跟着台词走。

zh.title: 美食桌面：模板、结构、拆解
zh.summary: 美食片不是食物特写合集；桌面、声音和 30 秒动作顺序决定它好不好吃。

zh.title: 课程视频：让观众学会，而不是看完
zh.summary: 课程片不是把知识念完，是设计一次能力变化；目标可做、练习可做、验收可做，才算教会。

zh.title: 房产空间：把户型拍成动线
zh.summary: 房产片不是扫房间，是让人看见一条生活动线：从进门到坐下，空间怎么被使用。

en.title: Product Ad: Hook in Three Seconds, Explain in Ten
en.summary: A product ad is not a product showcase. Give a problem in three seconds, one benefit in the middle, one action at the end.

en.title: Documentary Short: Capture a Change
en.summary: Find one person, then wait for one thing to happen. The film usually works because something changed between the first day and the last.

en.title: Brand Film: Make Them Believe One Sentence
en.summary: A brand film does not explain specs; it leaves one attitude. The product is evidence, not the protagonist.

en.title: Does the Cover Still Read at 200 Pixels?
en.summary: On a phone, a cover is the size of a thumb. Secure one face, one action, one contrast before adding type.

en.title: Vertical Drama: A Want in the First Three Seconds
en.summary: Vertical drama has no time for a world. Put a want in the first frame, an obstacle by the third second, and leave one question unanswered.

en.title: Talking Head: Write for the Ear
en.summary: A talking-head piece is not an article read aloud. The viewer cannot hear punctuation, only meaning. Keep sentences short, turn early, use concrete examples; if it cannot be said in one breath, split it.

en.title: Vlog Structure: Give the Place a Reason
en.summary: Give the place a reason before making it pretty; without reason, scenery is a screensaver.

en.title: Music Video Structure: The Song Is the Timeline
en.summary: Follow the song: verses give space, chorus gives a memory image, bridge gives the turn.

en.title: Wedding Film Structure: Ceremony Before Style
en.summary: Protect ceremony and vows before slow motion and grading; style cannot save a missed ritual.

en.title: Talking Head Breakdown: Hold Attention for Sixty Seconds
en.summary: An eight-beat breakdown of a sixty-second talking head: claim, reason, example one, example two, counter, proof, application, question.

en.title: Talking Head Template: One Claim, Three Proofs, One Action
en.summary: One claim, three proofs, one action; every proof must be visible on camera.

en.title: Product Ad Breakdown: Problem Becomes Proof
en.summary: A nine-beat breakdown of a sixty-second product ad: problem, failed fix, product, demo, proof, objection, second proof, result, action.

en.title: Product Ad Template: Three Seconds of Problem, Ten of Proof
en.summary: Three seconds of problem, ten of proof, five of action.

en.title: Documentary Breakdown: One Person, One Event, One Change
en.summary: An eight-beat breakdown of a three-minute documentary: action, person, want, obstacle, attempt, cost, change, after.

en.title: Documentary Template: One Person, One Thing, One Change
en.summary: One person, one concrete task, one visible change. Do not start with an era.

en.title: Brand Film Breakdown: Build a World in Ninety Seconds
en.summary: A nine-beat breakdown of a ninety-second brand film: world, character, want, obstacle, turn, action, resolve, line, hold.

en.title: Brand Film Template: Stance, Evidence, Landing
en.summary: Stance, evidence, landing. The stance must be arguable and the evidence concrete.

en.title: Short Drama Breakdown: One Turn in Thirty Seconds
en.summary: An eight-beat breakdown of a thirty-second short drama: image hook, claim, setup, escalation, false answer, clue, turn, reaction.

en.title: Short Drama Template: A Hook Every Thirty Seconds
en.summary: A hook every thirty seconds: new information, new obstacle, new cost.

en.title: Vlog Breakdown: One Discovery in Ninety Seconds
en.summary: An eight-beat breakdown of a ninety-second travel vlog: action, place, task, obstacle, failure, discovery, quiet, exit.

en.title: Vlog Template: Go, Meet, Change
en.summary: Go, meet, change. The change can be small, but it must happen.

en.title: News Structure: Scene First, Verification Second
en.summary: Scene first, verification second. Background first loses the viewer.

en.title: News Breakdown: Keep the Unknown in Ninety Seconds
en.summary: An eight-beat breakdown of a ninety-second news feature: verified fact, scene, witness, archive, context, known/unknown, unresolved, next.

en.title: News Template: Scene, Context, Impact
en.summary: Scene, context, impact; each section answers one viewer question.

en.title: Tutorial Structure: One Problem, One Skill
en.summary: One problem, one skill. Three tricks in one tutorial means none is learned.

en.title: Tutorial Breakdown: Teach in Five Minutes
en.summary: A ten-beat breakdown of a five-minute tutorial: result, materials, three steps, check, failure, recap, next, action.

en.title: Tutorial Template: Goal, Steps, Check
en.summary: Goal, steps, check; every step needs an observable result.

en.title: Music Video Breakdown: Map Song Structure to Image
en.summary: A nine-beat breakdown of a three-and-a-half-minute music video: intro motif, verse, pre-chorus, chorus, verse two, bridge, final chorus, outro, hold.

en.title: Music Video Template: Verse, Chorus, Memory
en.summary: Verse, chorus, memory. The memory can be one action or one image.

en.title: Wedding Breakdown: Six Minutes Without a Checklist
en.summary: An eleven-beat breakdown of a six-minute wedding film: prep, arrival, ceremony, vows, rings, family, reception, dance, quiet, portraits, exit.

en.title: Wedding Template: Opening, Ceremony, Blessing
en.summary: Opening, ceremony, blessing. The opening gives the day, not a dress close-up.

en.title: Event Film Structure: Result First, Process Second
en.summary: Result first, process second; the viewer needs to know what the event became.

en.title: Event Breakdown: Make a Live Event Clear in Ninety Seconds
en.summary: An eight-beat breakdown of a ninety-second event film: arrival, scale, key moment, detail, people, climax, aftermath, end card.

en.title: Event Template: Open, Live, Close
en.summary: Open, live, close. The live section needs ambience, not wall-to-wall music.

en.title: Interview Structure: The Question Matters More
en.summary: The question matters more than the camera; a vague question gets a vague answer.

en.title: Interview Breakdown: Make a Person Land in Three Minutes
en.summary: A nine-beat breakdown of a three-minute interview: answer hook, person at work, question one, evidence, question two, turn, context, close, hold.

en.title: Interview Template: Person, Question, Scene
en.summary: Person, question, scene. Shoot where they act before sitting them down.

en.title: Experimental Structure: Rules Before Effects
en.summary: Set rules first: locked camera, repeated action, one color. Clear rules make stronger effects.

en.title: Experimental Breakdown: Rule, Repetition, Break
en.summary: An eight-beat breakdown of a four-minute experimental film: pre-rule, rule, three repetitions, break, consequence, stop.

en.title: Corporate Video Structure: Six Beats
en.summary: Corporate video is not a company profile. Write a question the viewer wants answered, then prove with one person and one action that the company solves it.

en.title: Corporate Video Breakdown: Six Beats in Practice
en.summary: Composite sample: break corporate video into six beats and read picture, sound, and the pass line beat by beat; illustrative numbers are not client data.

en.title: Corporate Video Template: One Sheet to Shoot
en.summary: A one-sheet corporate video plan: six beats, picture, sound, duration, and pass line; fill it before rolling and run the set from it.

en.title: Sports Film Structure: Six Beats
en.summary: A sports film is not a slow-motion highlight. Set one physical goal—win, return, or accept failure—and let the body carry the story.

en.title: Sports Film Breakdown: Six Beats in Practice
en.summary: Composite sample: break sports film into six beats and read picture, sound, and the pass line beat by beat; illustrative numbers are not client data.

en.title: Sports Film Template: One Sheet to Shoot
en.summary: A one-sheet sports film plan: six beats, picture, sound, duration, and pass line; fill it before rolling and run the set from it.

en.title: Food & Table Structure: Six Beats
en.summary: Food video is not a rotating platter. Shoot change: raw to cooked, cold to hot, whole to cut. Sound is the second dish; hands persuade more than words.

en.title: Food & Table Breakdown: Six Beats in Practice
en.summary: Composite sample: break food & table into six beats and read picture, sound, and the pass line beat by beat; illustrative numbers are not client data.

en.title: Food & Table Template: One Sheet to Shoot
en.summary: A one-sheet food & table plan: six beats, picture, sound, duration, and pass line; fill it before rolling and run the set from it.

en.title: Real Estate & Space Structure: Six Beats
en.summary: Real-estate video is not a wide-angle building tour. Start with the life problem of who lives here, then prove it with space; every shot answers one living question.

en.title: Real Estate & Space Breakdown: Six Beats in Practice
en.summary: Composite sample: break real estate & space into six beats and read picture, sound, and the pass line beat by beat; illustrative numbers are not client data.

en.title: Real Estate & Space Template: One Sheet to Shoot
en.summary: A one-sheet real estate & space plan: six beats, picture, sound, duration, and pass line; fill it before rolling and run the set from it.

en.title: Fashion & Beauty Structure: Six Beats
en.summary: Fashion and beauty is not a runway clip. Define texture first—fabric, skin, light—and prove it with close-ups and action, not a beauty filter.

en.title: Fashion & Beauty Breakdown: Six Beats in Practice
en.summary: Composite sample: break fashion & beauty into six beats and read picture, sound, and the pass line beat by beat; illustrative numbers are not client data.

en.title: Fashion & Beauty Template: One Sheet to Shoot
en.summary: A one-sheet fashion & beauty plan: six beats, picture, sound, duration, and pass line; fill it before rolling and run the set from it.

en.title: Live & Podcast Structure: Six Beats
